# Cripta

Cripta is a free browser tool that checks your readiness for EU DAC8 (Directive (EU) 2023/2226) crypto-asset tax reporting. It runs entirely in the browser (no data leaves the device).

## Key facts (verified 13 August 2026)

- DAC8 entered into force on 1 January 2026.
- Reporting Crypto-Asset Service Providers (RCASPs) must collect reportable transaction data of EU-resident users from 1 January 2026.
- First reporting period: the entire calendar year 2026.
- Reporting due within 9 months of the first fiscal year — between 1 January and 30 September 2027 (member states set specific dates; NL: 31 January 2027).
- First exchange of 2026 data between member states: by 30 September 2027.
- Scope follows MiCA definitions, plus decentralised crypto-assets, stablecoins (incl. e-money tokens) and certain NFTs.
- Penalties are set by member states (some have introduced fines from EUR 20,000 up to 900,000).

## Pricing

- Free: reporting check + checklist + first-report window.
- Pro (16 USD one-time, crypto via NOWPayments): printable readiness stamp PDF, CY2026 data-collection checklist, DAC8/CARF field mapping reference, permanent unlock.

## Not advice

Cripta is an educational tool based on Directive (EU) 2023/2226. It is not tax or legal advice. Editorial responsibility: attenciona (Holding), Spain.
